description.full: Manufacturing Wave 2 Cowork plugin: NCR to closed CAPA. Picks up where Quality Inspection & Nonconformance (01) leaves off - reads the open NCR, complaint and inspection data; establishes root cause with a structured method (pareto + rca_tree engines); builds corrective and preventive actions with mandatory effectiveness checks (capa_logic engine); validates closure readiness (explicit Govern step); drafts the 8D / CAPA report cited to the clause. Draft-first; document-grounded.
